 Harry Kane's Karim Benzema tribute proves why fans wanted him at Real Madrid 
 By Hridyam Arora | Nov 19, 2026, 3:13 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Real Valladolid V Real Madrid - La Liga Santander | Europa Press Sports/GettyImages Bayern Munich striker and Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane heaped praise on former Real Madrid forward Karim Benzema in a recent interview with Footmercato. He talked about Benzema, Benzema's astonishing 2022 season, as well as the similarities between his and the Frenchman's game.
--> Bayern Munich striker and Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane heaped praise on former Real Madrid forward Karim Benzema in a recent interview with Footmercato. He talked about Benzema, Benzema's astonishing 2022 season, as well as the similarities between his and the Frenchman's game.
 He said, "Karim Benzema is an incredible player. I have always been a big admirer of him. What he achieved at Real Madrid in 2022 was truly impressive. He has his ability to drop deep into midfield and play almost like a number 10, dictating the game while also arriving in the box at the perfect moment. We have slightly different physical characteristics, but in terms of game intelligence, the ability to find space, and the desire to help the players around us, I clearly see many similarities in our style of football. We have both shown that you don't always need to be in the box to score goals."

 This is the profile that is missing from football the most at the moment. Benzema and Kane are those sorts of selfless strikers who not only score a lot of goals but also make the team tick. Even during his struggling years, Benzema was able to showcase some brilliant football IQ, which translated into the rest of the team. Real Madrid played much, much better football whenever he was on the pitch because he was able to combine every single move that the team tried to make. He used his intelligence to have brilliant link-up play with fellow forwards, while also contributing to the attack with excellent off-ball movement and finishing.
